sections.title: Going to a place
sections.content: To say where you are going, put *-ba* or *-be* on the place: back vowels take *-ba*, front vowels take *-be*, and a final *-a* or *-e* lengthens. The verb is *megy*: *megyek, mész, megy*. Ask *Hová mész?* (Where are you going?) and answer *A múzeumba megyek.* New words: *turista* (tourist) and *térkép* (map).

items.english: Where are you going? – I am going to the museum.
Anna is going to the restaurant.
The tourist is going to the hotel.
Károly is going to the bank.

sections.content: Compare *a bankban* (in the bank) and *a bankba* (into the bank): only the last letter differs.
